conditions.text: The current weekly output of 1,000 is approximate, as stated by the user, rather than an exact measured baseline.

Olumi's provisional oven effect of 100–300 additional loaves a week is an illustrative planning range, not an evidence-based forecast. It assumes oven capacity constrains current output and enough staff, preparation capacity and demand exist to use some added capacity. Oven size, utilisation and other bottlenecks were not supplied; the range must be tested and could be wrong.

Olumi's provisional opening-hours effect of 50–200 additional loaves a week is an illustrative planning range, not an evidence-based forecast. It assumes the extension includes staffed baking time, not merely more retail opening time. The number of extra hours, spare oven capacity and staffing were not supplied; the range must be tested and could be wrong.

Any quarter-end calculation assumes the selected change is operational and its full weekly effect is realised by the end of the quarter. Installation timing and the start of longer hours have not been supplied.
Costs, profitability and customer purchases are not quantified here. The stated target is weekly loaves baked; more output does not by itself establish profitable sales.

For calculation, Olumi proposes a Normal effect for the second oven with mean increase 200 loaves a week and standard deviation 50 loaves a week, and a Normal effect for longer hours with mean increase 125 loaves a week and standard deviation 40 loaves a week. All four figures and both distribution choices are untested Olumi assumptions, not evidence-based forecasts or user-supplied figures. These replace the original range effects. The original notes about 100–300 and 50–200 extra loaves a week are retained as context about the initial planning illustrations and their capacity and staffing assumptions; they are not hard bounds on the new Normal effects. Normal distributions are unbounded. The approximate baseline, quarter-end full-effect assumption and exclusions for costs, profitability and purchases are unchanged.
